lead.event: MSCI's proposed Indonesia reclassification prompts public and regulatory responses
lead.headline: MSCI's proposed Indonesia reclassification prompts three OJK measures
lead.blurb: MSCI proposed moving Indonesia from Emerging Market to Standalone Market, which would remove Indonesian stocks from its main global indices. OJK urged the Indonesia Stock Exchange (BEI) to make its high-shareholding-concentration methodology more transparent and strengthen trade surveillance, and extended issuer buybacks without shareholder approval through June 2027. OJK cited strong issuer interest amid market volatility. MSCI's consultation runs through 30 April 2027, with a decision due by 30 June 2027; no final decision has been made.

market_structure_policy.event: IDX will exclude high-shareholding-concentration stocks from the JCI
market_structure_policy.headline: IDX will exclude 80 HSC stocks from the JCI from 2 November
market_structure_policy.blurb: Mirae Asset Sekuritas estimates the 80 stocks account for 18.41% of the index. Their weights will be redistributed among remaining constituents while they retain HSC status, with the divisor adjusted so the JCI level remains unchanged.

market_structure_policy.event: Danantara targets closures or liquidations of 750 state-owned companies
market_structure_policy.headline: Danantara targets 750 state-owned company closures or liquidations
market_structure_policy.blurb: COO Dony Oskaria said 364 of 1,074 state-owned companies have been closed in 18 months. Danantara is pursuing the year-end target through consolidation, mergers, divestments and liquidations, and plans to divest 208 non-core companies.

market_structure_policy.event: Danantara prepares Rp200 trillion in reinvestment from SOE dividends
market_structure_policy.headline: Danantara prepares Rp200 trillion for SOE dividend reinvestment
market_structure_policy.blurb: COO Dony Oskaria said SOE dividends are the fund’s primary funding source. A five-year transformation plan targets fewer than 200 companies and around 700 SOE closures by year-end.

market_structure_policy.event: TGUK's change of control leads to an IDX board transfer
market_structure_policy.headline: TGUK moves to IDX development board after foreign investor takes 56.84% voting stake
market_structure_policy.blurb: Platinum Wahab leaves the special monitoring board on 27 October after Visionary Capital bought 2.03 billion shares at Rp20 each on 2 October, raising its voting stake from 0% to 56.84%. Visionary Capital says it will maintain control.

capital_raising_buybacks.headline: BBRI plans second-phase share buyback of up to Rp1 trillion
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: The planned period runs from 22 October 2026 to 21 January 2027. BRI plans to use the shares for an employee share ownership program and/or members of its board of directors and board of commissioners, subject to General Meeting of Shareholders approval. Pro forma consolidated capital adequacy ratio and return on equity as of 30 June 2026 were 21.42% and 18.80%.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Bank Mandiri extends a Rp40 trillion credit facility to Jhonlin Baratama
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: BMRI extends Rp40 trillion credit facility to Jhonlin Baratama
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Jhonlin Baratama has drawn Rp17 trillion to fund capital expenditure and financing needs in the coal industry and related businesses. The facility is secured by fixed and non-fixed assets, including shares in JARR and PGUN, with collateral coverage of 150% based on their lowest intraday prices over the past month.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Bank Syariah Indonesia prepares a Rp500 billion share buyback
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: BRIS prepares Rp500 billion share buyback
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Bank Syariah Indonesia plans purchases through the IDX from 27 October to 26 January 2027, either gradually or all at once, capped at 20% of paid-in capital. Management says the buyback will not affect operations or future growth, citing sufficient capital adequacy.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Adhi Karya begins implementation of Rp3 trillion debt restructuring agreement
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: ADHI begins implementing Rp3 trillion debt restructuring agreement
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Adhi Karya’s MRA took effect on 23 October after Bank Mandiri confirmed all conditions were met. The terms include Rp1.55 trillion in 15-year balloon debt at 3.5% a year, Rp1.46 trillion in five-year bullet debt at 1% funded by divestments, and accrued interest repaid interest-free over 18 months. Bank Mandiri, BRI and BNI are creditors.

deals_control.event: BRMS sees a Rp1.3 trillion negotiated-market block trade
deals_control.headline: BRMS sees Rp1.3 trillion negotiated-market block trade
deals_control.blurb: The trade covered 30.5 million lots at Rp432 per share across two transactions on 26 October. BRMS shares fell 1.39% to Rp426 on the regular market, with 280.7 million shares traded.

deals_control.headline: ARKO executives buy 1.35 million shares
deals_control.blurb: ARKO founder and President Director Aldo Artoko bought 1.05 million shares at Rp1,405 each, lifting his stake to 0.22%. President Commissioner Arya Pradana Setiadharma bought 300,000 shares at Rp1,398 each, raising his stake to 0.08%.

deals_control.event: Bumi Resources acquires Australia's Mount Margaret Mining
deals_control.headline: BUMI acquires Mount Margaret Mining for US$22.01 million
deals_control.blurb: Bumi Resources completed the deal on 23 October, taking indirect 100% ownership of the Australian copper and gold miner. Its Queensland project holds roughly 13 million tons of ore resources, while BUMI shares had risen more than 20% over the previous week.

earnings_guidance.headline: BUKA reports nine-month 2026 net loss after Rp2.91 trillion profit
earnings_guidance.blurb: Bukalapak's adjusted EBITDA was positive at Rp11 billion, up Rp64 billion from a Rp53 billion loss a year earlier. Net revenue rose 19.34% to Rp5.64 trillion, while an investment value loss of Rp2.04 trillion reversed a Rp2.32 trillion gain.

earnings_guidance.event: Master Print reports nine-month 2026 profit turnaround
earnings_guidance.headline: PTMR reports nine-month profit turnaround to Rp9.19 billion
earnings_guidance.blurb: Master Print swung from a Rp10.93 billion loss in the same period last year, while revenue fell 7.68% to Rp89.82 billion. Operating profit turned positive at Rp13.3 billion, helped by Rp5 billion in other income and lower administrative expenses.

earnings_guidance.event: DCI Indonesia reports nine-month revenue and profit growth
earnings_guidance.headline: DCII reports 31.49% revenue and 11.5% net profit growth
earnings_guidance.blurb: DCI Indonesia's revenue reached Rp2.52 trillion and net profit Rp919.84 billion in the first nine months of 2026. Colocation generated Rp2.38 trillion, or 94.27% of revenue.

earnings_guidance.event: Danantara reports SOE net profit of Rp214.9 trillion
earnings_guidance.headline: Danantara reports SOE net profit of Rp214.9 trillion
earnings_guidance.blurb: Danantara said full-year 2026 SOE net income could reach at least Rp360 trillion. COO Dony Oskaria said profits were expected to be returned as dividends, reinvested and used to amplify project financing with at least 30% equity.
earnings_guidance.copy_decision: rewritten: moved from flash to story

other.event: MBSS signs a five-year coal-hauling contract with GEL Group
other.headline: MBSS signs five-year coal-hauling contract worth up to Rp6 trillion
other.blurb: The agreement with GEL Group covers 500,000 metric tons a month, with potential total volume of 30 million tons. It could generate average revenue of around Rp1.2 trillion a year, subject to service execution and transport volumes, and Mitrabahtera plans significant fleet expansion in 2027 to support the contract.
other.copy_decision: rewritten: 2 new articles with a new fact: The five-year contract is valued at up to Rp6 trillion.

other.event: Ancora Indonesia Resources secures USD67 million in mining contracts
other.headline: OKAS secures USD67 million in mining contracts
other.blurb: The awards include USD11 million for open-pit blasting in East Kalimantan and USD49 million at a major Indonesian mine, with contracts running through 2029 and 2030. A non-coal mining company also awarded an underground blasting contract worth about USD7 million annually.
